description:
Operator-only: expose a catalog query as a named, typed MCP tool.

Projects the published query as a first-class tool named ``cypher_<key>``
whose flat, typed parameters come from the query's param schema (e.g.
``cypher_which_service_handles(keyword)``). The tool is registered
immediately but starts **unpriced** — it appears in Pricing Studio like any
new tool; set its price there. Until priced, calls return "not priced yet
(TBD)". Patrons then call it by name with typed params instead of
``execute_query_by_key``.

The key must be a valid tool identifier (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$). Reconnect to
see the new tool in the tool list.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

tool_intent.description:
One-line description shown as the tool's purpose
(defaults to the query's description).

name: cypher_publish_tool
title: Publish a query as a tool
